主要内容: On May 2, 2013, Geospace Technologies Corp appointed Mr. Richard F. Miles to fill a vacancy on the Board of Directors. Mr. Miles was previously the Chief Executive Officer and a member of the Board of Directors of Geokinetics Inc, a customer of the Company. Between October 1, 2011, and the date of Mr. Miles' retirement from Geokinetics, the Company sold an aggregate amount of $3.8 million of equipment to Geokinetics in 139 separate transactions, and the Company rented equipment to Geokinetics in 7 separate transactions with an aggregate rental fee of $7.1 million. As a director, Mr. Miles is eligible to receive compensation in the amount of $85,000 annually.
